title: fix(plugin-designer, app-shell): app writers save a packaged app at its package
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8AJJJRiYjshMUNgyMZSqBsr)_

Fixes #35115
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：控制台「编辑应用」向导和导航同步（新建/删除页面、仪表盘时自动改应用导航）在保存属于某个软件包的应用时，现在带上该包（`?package=`），与读取时用的是同一个地址；不属于任何包的应用保持原来的无包地址。
- 为什么改：之前读的是包里的那一行，写却落到无包地址，编辑一个包内应用（名称、导航）可能写到错误的层，不在应用所属的包里。
- 风险与回滚：只改两处前端写入的地址；受管包的密封应用（ADR-0131 D6）在任一地址都被服务端拒绝，导航同步也照旧跳过它，没有放宽写入面。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useNavigationSync.ts`（新增 `appAddress`，读、写、撤销共用它）；`ui/packages/plugin-designer/src/pages/EditAppPage.tsx`（保存带 `servedPackageId`）；两个 `*-35115` 测试文件。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-designer/src/__tests__/EditAppPage.packageScope-35115.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useNavigationSync.packageScope-35115.test.tsx`，预期 2 个文件、6 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- [x] **N3.** Both console app writers now read and save an app at the package that owns it.
  - `EditAppPage` already read the stored app at the served `_packageId`; its save now passes the same package as `{ packageId }` (the SDK sends `?package=`). One `owningPackage` reading decides the address for both the read and the save, the same reading App management's `saveApp` uses: a missing `_packageId` and the server's `sys_metadata` sentinel are package-less, so a package-less app keeps the package-less read and save (a three-argument `saveItem`, byte-identical to before).
  - `useNavigationSync` gains `appAddress(appName)`: the served app's name and its owning package (`isPackageLessItem` from `studioScope`, the existing package-less predicate). `storedApp` reads at it, and `saveApp` (so every navigation write and every Undo) saves at it.
  - ADR-0131 D6 holds: the all-apps writes still skip a sealed managed app (`isNavigationSyncableApp`, unchanged), and the server's save door refuses a write onto an artifact-backed app of a type with no overlay channel whether or not the write names its package (`refusePackagedBaseOverride`: `ITEM_LOCKED` when it names the read-only base, `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` otherwise). Naming the package writes nothing the package-less save did not.
- [ ] **N1, left unticked.** No existing locale key fits `edit-app-load-failed` ("Application NAME could not be read for editing: REASON"): the `appDesigner.*` group holds wizard chrome only, and `common.*` has no read-failure sentence. `EditAppPage` uses no translation hook at all, and its sibling strings (not found, the success and failure toasts) are hard-coded too. A new key means every locale pack plus the `DESIGNER_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` mirror, which is beyond a copy nit.
- [ ] **N2, left unticked; its premise is half gone.** Measured on the code: a *refused* authored read already shows its own message. `getAuthoredItem` rejects with the `MetadataError` its `parseError` builds from the server's `error.message`, and the page's `reason()` passes that `message` through. The "unknown error" comes only from the *empty* read (`getAuthoredItem` answers `null` when no layer holds the app), where `saveApp` throws a bare `Error()` and there is no server sentence to show. Saying something better there needs a new `appManagement.toast.*` key in every pack, so it is left.

## Tests

- New pins, one file per writer, named for this card:
  - `ui/packages/plugin-designer/src/__tests__/EditAppPage.packageScope-35115.test.tsx`: a packaged app is read and saved at its package; a package-less app, and one served with `sys_metadata`, read with `{}` and save with three arguments.
  - `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useNavigationSync.packageScope-35115.test.tsx`: the same three cases for a navigation write, including the Undo save.
- One existing assertion changed: `useNavigationSync.authoredApp-35054.test.tsx` pinned the package-less read of its packaged fixture (`_packageId: 'com.qa.tr'`), the defect this card fixes; it now expects `{ packageId: 'com.qa.tr' }`.

## Acceptance notes

- `useNavigationSync` now writes at the served app's `name`, not at the `appName` argument: the two differ only when a caller passes a route segment (a package id), which no in-repo caller does (the all-apps methods pass `app.name`).
- The `sys_metadata` sentinel constant now has one more module-local copy (`EditAppPage`, beside `MetadataObjectsPage`, `AppManagementPage`, `studioScope` and `appRoute`); plugin-designer cannot import app-shell's predicate. Not filed: no defect, a consolidation.
- The write address was measured at the unit layer (the `saveItem` options the page and hook hand the SDK, and `metaSaveQuery` turning `packageId` into `?package=`); NOT MEASURED live against a booted server.
